ctx.x: When Capone came to a club, would you go and talk to him, say hello to him? You could, sure. I mean, did you do it sometimes?

I spoke to him, yeah. Fosco was the one that you've seen in those days. Joe Fosco. Was he a big shot? He was in the days, the real days of Prohibition. He was a beer runner. A beer runner? Uh-huh. And later on he became one of the big guys, you know. Oh, yeah. Joe Fosco. What happened to him? Fosco? I think he's still there, huh? You know, I was up in a club, in a barrage club. In fact I was the last one to get out of there, when Hershey Miller and Nails Martin shot those two policemen, a lieutenant and a…
Well he would fool us if he didn't. Did it seem like he could read music? Sure. Really? Sure.
